title: Awesome
body: It would be great to see a feature that allows importing habits from the app into Apple Reminders for better integration with other tools.
author: evgnine

title: Good app
body: For now, I have tried a increment habit’s counter, but I haven’t found a way to undo it. Also I was frustrated by the screenshot of the app in the store - no more that 10 glasses of alcohol per week? Imagined the typical app user as an alcoholic, no offence… Otherwise, seems good.
author: vershart
